description: Generate a branded PDF report from a diagnostic or audit result. Provide an audit_id to load from history, or pass inline result data. Saves the PDF to disk and returns the file path.

audit_id.description: ID of a history entry (from get_audit_history). Mutually exclusive with inline data.

client_name.description: Optional: client name for the report filename.

report_data.description: JSON string of the structured result. Required if audit_id is not provided.

report_type.description: Required if providing inline data. "diagnostic" or "audit".

name: generate_report
